messages:
Alex: Quick preflight — snapshot/hand-off for console observability. Need short statuses for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestone. Who owns final signoff? :eyes:
Priya: I'll own dashboards end-to-end. Current milestone: v1 tiles wired + perms. ETA for staging is EOD Wed. PRs: #4212, #4220. Need infra to expose metrics prefix `console.*` to signalboard.
Marco: Tracing hooks: basic spans in place for generation path. Hook PR #4301 in review (cc @Dana for error context). Need a small change from eng-infra to add header propagation for request-id across proxy.
Dana: Error-analysis views: wiring alerting + grouping by error_signature. Dashboard filters TBD. I can ship a lightweight view by Tue if Marco's hook lands first. Blocking: need sample payloads from api-team (ping @Jose for schema).
Jose: Retention/ingest: proposed retention plan is 30d traces, 90d aggregated metrics. Infra note: S3 lifecycle rule needs update; I created infra ticket INF-987. Also need a cost estimate before we commit to 30d for traces.
Alex: Ownership note: Priya = dashboards, Marco = tracing hooks, Dana = error views, Jose = retention/ingest. Alex is final signoff on the release.
Priya: Quick ask — can eng-sre open the namespace and bump the Prom exporter scrape interval? Current default causes noisy metrics. @eng-sre :wave:
Marco: Added a tiny code snippet to the PR to show header propagation:
```
// set request id
req.Header.Set("X-Request-Id", ctx.Value("req_id"))
```
Dana: For error grouping I'm using this deterministic stringifier (wip):
```
groupKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s", err.Type, stackSummary(err.Stack, 3))
```
Alex: Good. Two blockers to clear: infra for header propagation & metrics prefix; api-team to provide sample error payloads. Once clear, we can schedule a staging run for Thu.
Priya: I'll coordinate staging run and write a short playbook. Anyone want to co-author? :raised_hands:
Jose: I'll drop the infra ticket link and rough cost calc in the ticket today.
obs-bot: deploy-check: staging cluster health OK, image build 17 passed, canary tests fail 2/12 (timeouts in trace ingestion). See CI: https://ci.example/17
Marco: I'll look into the canary timeout, might be related to header propagation not being present in the canary env. Will follow up with logs.
Dana: I'll start the error view skeleton in a branch and add examples. PR ref will be shared here when ready.
Alex: Thanks — next sync if blockers remain Fri 10am. If all green, we'll merge and plan Friday EOD release. :thumbsup:
